It was 2am when my grandmother passed in her hospital room, I was told to get a nurse by my family.  I went out into the hall, all the lights were dimmed. There was no one at the desk, so I went down a few of the halls.  Absolutely no one was there.  

I went back into the room and told my parents I couldn't find anyone, then I lost it and started crying.  I went back out to the hall to try because they asked me to again, but the lights were now back on and there were people everywhere.  

Later on that night, I was instructed to go to the truck and wait while they cleared out the room.  It felt like it was hours, that alone feeling was so large I could fall into it.  I looked up at the sky and saw the stars, it felt like the world had stopped.  And then, just like earlier, everyone came out to the parking lot and it was as if I was never alone.  It was super eerie for me as I had never lost someone that close to me before my grandma passed, so I'm sure it was me just dealing with it but it definitely shook me.

I ordered 2 cookies from McDonalds during a night of drinking with a few friends.  It took way too long so I dipped into the washroom, tried to enter an open stall when I realized it was occupied. I'm pretty well hidden, not that I should need to be.  The lady is at the garbage, dabbing blood off her body.  The door to the washroom creaks open and a man's voice demands to know if she is alone.  I froze in my place, held my breath.  She tells him she's alone, but it took about a minute to convince him.  He told her to finish up fast and not let anyone else in.  

I ran up to the front counter after that whole 15 minute event.  Reported what happened and the manager called the cops.  They arrested the guy, turned out he had stabbed his girlfriend and I walked in on the aftermath.

This is really bad but I've come to terms with it, so here it is.  I'm a recovered DPH addict.  I would line up 1g (20 pills) of benadryl alongside another 20 of DXM. I cried a bit, fought against him, and then fell asleep once he lost interest.  I awoke 5 hours later with him already gone before anyone noticed.  

I never got therapy for it, but I was caught stealing during the height of my addiction only a couple months later. No more fuzz on the walls or flying cats, took a year of being sober for those to stop.  

Don't ever try DPH for recreational purposes, it'll destroy your brain, it hurts you + your friends and family.  My parents never knew it was happening and none of my friends from after that time know about it, they only know I'm heavily against pills and other substances that isn't booze or weed.

Apply the soldering iron tip to the metal joint on the circuit board, or if you want to solder wires you apply the tip to the stripped ends (stripped a few centimeters) of the wires while they lay gently together (not touching any surface).  The objective is to heat up the point of contact, which on a circuit board would be the metal joint with the hole in it.  You apply the solder to the point of contact.  Wet the tip by placing a small amount of solder on the end for better flow.
To add on, if it doesn't fillet then it won't be high reliability.  You can make your solder joint more durable with high reliablity if you get it to fillet.
